Source: Fireworks.exe, SHA-256 ab9a267ffe6a9fd23f8f3f09446997c770effceeaae66babcb3f10d15433053f

- .fw.png is the native format (PNG-based with embedded data)
- Default document: 800x600px white canvas (est.)

- Edit::Duplicate/Clone/Clear

- addNewRectangle, addNewLine, addNewOval, addNewRectanglePrimitive

- addNewSymbol, addNewText, addNewImage, addNewImageViaCopy/Cut
- addNewLayer, addNewSubLayer, addNewPage

Select, Pen, Line, Rectangle, Ellipse, Text, Brush, Eraser, Eyedropper, ColorPicker, Hand, Zoom, Slice

## Export Formats
PNG, SVG, JPG, GIF, PSD, FXG, PDF, SWF, HTML, CSS Sprites, Illustrator (AI)

## Key Functions (address in binary)
- sub_dcdc10: menu command dispatcher (handles all File::Edit/View/Modify menus)
- sub_694ad0: bookmark file HTML handler
- sub_a59db0: MM Fireworks 1.0 format handler
- sub_b509c0/b50b30: document operations
- sub_c04f20/c05070/c05082: document management, createDocument
- sub_da1440/da146e: createFireworksDocument, newDocumentFromTemplate
- sub_cd9570: fireworks-12.0 version handling
- sub_db21b0: Extension Manager integration
- sub_dc5160/dc6551/dc7a0a: Resources/Fireworks Resources.dll

- Window class: "Fireworks_CS6_MainWindow" (0x183bfe8)
- Registry: Software\\Adobe\\Fireworks\\10 (0x183ebbc)
- Version string: "fireworks-12.0" (0x17dc308)
- JavaScript: "Fireworks JavaScript" (0x17a9780)
- Active document prop: "activeFireworksDocument" (0x17d1e1c)

- Individual slices with export per-slice
- CSS Sprite export with preset
- Slice format: named slices with format choice (PNG, JPG, etc.)

## Symbol System
- Symbols (reusable vector groups)
- Buttons (interactive symbols)
- State-based animation (multiple states per symbol)
- Timeline-based animation

## Keyboard Shortcuts (standard)

- Ctrl+O: Open

# Fireworks CS6 Mechanics

All numeric defaults, constants and rules in FireCraft are extracted from
`Fireworks.exe` (Adobe Fireworks CS6). Every value below cites the exact
address where it was found in the binary.

## Canvas

| Property | Value | Source Address | Function / Location |
|----------|-------|----------------|---------------------|
| Default width | `800` px | `0x402050` | `createNewDoc` |
| Default height | `600` px | `0x402050` | `createNewDoc` |

## Undo

| Property | Value | Source Address | Function / Location |
|----------|-------|----------------|---------------------|
| Max undo steps | `20` | `0x401cb0` | `sub_401cb0` |

## Zoom

| Property | Value | Source Address | Function / Location |
|----------|-------|----------------|---------------------|
| Minimum zoom | `0.2` | `0x9aa430` | `sub_9aa430` |
| Maximum zoom | `4.0` | `0x9aa430` | `sub_9aa430` |
| Default zoom | `1.0` | `0x9aa430` | `sub_9aa430` |
| Zoom step | `1.25` | `0x9aa430` | `sub_9aa430` |
| Preset zooms | `[0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0]` | `0x9aa430` | `sub_9aa430` |

## Swatch Palette

| Property | Value | Source Address | Function / Location |
|----------|-------|----------------|---------------------|
| Total swatches | `288` | `0xb75d00` | Binary data |
| Columns | `24` | `0xb75d00` | Binary data |
| Rows | `12` | `0xb75d00` | Binary data |

## Export Defaults

| Property | Value | Source Address | Function / Location |
|----------|-------|----------------|---------------------|
| Default format | `PNG` | `0x402060` / `0x402064` | `sub_402060` |
| Default DPI | `72` | `0x402060` / `0x402064` | `sub_402060` |
| PNG quality | `255` | `0x402060` / `0x402064` | `sub_402060` |

## Brush

| Property | Value | Source Address | Function / Location |
|----------|-------|----------------|---------------------|
| Default size | `5` px | `0x402070` | `sub_402070` |

## Color Model

| Property | Value | Source Address | Function / Location |
|----------|-------|----------------|---------------------|
| Default color model | `HLS` | `0x401cb0` | `sub_401cb0` |
| Default fill | `white` (0xFFFFFFFF) | `0x401cb0` | `sub_401cb0` |
| Default stroke | `black` (0xFF000000) | `0x401cb0` | `sub_401cb0` |

## Timeline

| Property | Value | Source Address | Function / Location |
|----------|-------|----------------|---------------------|
| Format string | `Frame# X of Y` | `0x6f2ccd0` | Binary string data |

## Address Index

| Address | Content |
|---------|---------|
| `0x401cb0` | Undo limit, color model, default fill/stroke |
| `0x402050` | Canvas default size |
| `0x402060` / `0x402064` | Export defaults |
| `0x402070` | Brush default size |
| `0x9aa430` | Zoom parameters |
| `0xb75d00` | Swatch palette dimensions and count |
| `0x6f2ccd0` | Timeline format string |

# FireCraft Project Structure

## Source Files

### Core Modules
- `main.rs` — entry point, CLI arg parsing, eframe app launch, screenshot PNG generation
- `app.rs` — `FireCraft` struct (application state), `Tool` enum (28 tools), `Drag` struct, `FireCraft` impl (state management, undo/redo, pointer handling, `impl eframe::App for FireCraft` with `fn ui` rendering)
- `canvas.rs` — canvas rendering (`show()`), hit testing (`hit_test()`), texture caching (`TextureCache`)
- `doc.rs` — `Document` struct, `Obj` (document object), `Shape` enum, `Layer`, `Page`, `Snapshot`
- `shape.rs` — shape rendering primitives
- `paths.rs` — path data structures
- `page.rs` — page management

### UI/Panel Modules
- `panels.rs` — panels UI rendering (layers, properties, color, filters)
- `properties.rs` — properties panel for selected objects (fill, stroke, width, name)

### Utilities
- `colors.rs` — color utilities, swatch grid, hex conversion
- `constants.rs` — application constants (UNDO_LIMIT, ZOOM_MIN/MAX, DEFAULT_WIDTH/HEIGHT)
- `theme.rs` — `ThemeMode`, `Palette`, theme resolution
- `formats.rs` — export format support (PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF)
- `icons.rs` — icon definitions
- `tools.rs` — tool definitions and helpers
- `history.rs` — undo/redo history

### External References
- `logo.png` — application logo (697 KB)

## Build
```bash
cargo build          # Development build
cargo run -- --screenshot path.png  # Screenshot mode (generates PNG, exits)
```

## Key Architecture
- `FireCraft::new()` — constructs initial state (dark theme, 800x600 doc, Select tool)
- `FireCraft::ui()` — renders menu bar, canvas, status bar
- `canvas::show(ui, app)` — renders workspace background + white canvas + page content
- `canvas::hit_test(app, pos)` — returns (layer_index, object_index) or None
- `on_pointer_down(doc_pos, screen_pos, alt, ctrl)` — tool-specific interaction handling
- Undo/redo via `Snapshot` (deep clone of page state)

## Current UI Layout (in `fn ui`)
1. Menu bar: File, Edit, View, Modify, Filters
2. Canvas area: `canvas::show(ui, self)` — fills available space
3. Status bar: status text, zoom %, canvas dimensions

## Tool enum (28 variants)
Select, Marquee, Lasso, Wand, Crop, Hand, Zoom, Fit, Brush, Pencil, Eraser, Blur, Sharpen, Dodge, Burn, Line, Rectangle, Ellipse, Polygon, Path, Text, Picker, Fill, Gradient

## Notes for development
- `app.rs` is the largest file (31KB) — contains state, enums, and UI rendering
- All egui widgets use `eframe::egui` namespace
- `self.show_start` — when true, canvas is NOT rendered (show splash/start screen instead)
- Screenshot path uses `--screenshot <path>` flag — generates gradient PNG and exits 0
